title: skills: SKILL.md becomes a router with a size budget, and points to the contract instead of restating it
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic), filed on the maintainer's word in this seat's chat, 2026-11-17, verbatim: 「三点都同意，按最终计划把后续里程碑的卡全部立出来」, and, on the list of thirteen cards the seat then showed: 「同意」. The ruling records are #34659 comment 6940528935 and #34691 comment 6943107981. Readings: objectstack `a0326b06`, cloud `53a5844`, 2026-11-17.

## Why

The platform is defined by its metadata protocol; a skill that copies option lists and key tables from it drifts from it, and costs the reader's context on every load. A long skill also hides its few critical traps among reference text the model skips.

Who acts: the skills lane (`skills/objectstack-{data,ui,automation}/**` first). Governed surface.

## Evidence

- Each `SKILL.md` is 15–27 KB; the data skill is 174 KB with its rules and references, the UI skill 123 KB; the catalog is about 1.0 MB.
- Across the vendor sets read, the median `SKILL.md` is 6.6–8.7 KB; Clerk enforces 500 lines / 5,000 tokens in a script; Directus keeps the router near 100 lines with at most about 8 traps inline.
- In this seat's eval run a case failed because the model invoked the skill and never opened the reference file that held the answer (`objectstack-ui/analytics-inline-vs-dataset#5`).
- Supabase and Directus skills tell the agent to read the live schema before proposing anything, and say not to re-document tool parameters.

## Scope

- Per skill: `SKILL.md` holds first checks (version, read what exists, read the type's contract), at most about 8 traps that pass the schema and fail at run time, and a routing list to the references. Budget 6–9 KB, hard cap 500 lines.
- Restated option lists and key tables move behind a pointer to the generated reference index or to the contract a door serves.
- Start with data, UI and automation; the others follow the same shape in later PRs.
- No trap is removed until a publish-time check covers it or it stays inline.

## Done when

- The three skills meet the budget; their eval cases pass at least as often as before on the runner card's round.
- The catalog total falls toward 0.5 MB.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Decision record: #34691 S3 = A. Related: the six-checks card (traps that become checks leave the skill).
- Dedup, open and closed: none found for `SKILL.md size budget`.
